correctness.rationale: The source constructs the 60-vertex cubic truncated-icosahedral graph explicitly from oriented flags of the icosahedron, giving 90 edges. It verifies degree-15 annihilating polynomial P(A)=0 on each of 60 basis vectors and 120 symmetry permutations partitioning 1770 unordered vertex pairs into 23 orbits. Exact rational elimination of 60×30 Krylov blocks produces 15:30,27:60,28:120,29:1560 and checks intrinsic antipode/spoke/distance-five path-multiplicity if-and-only-if rules. Independently built the graph and diagonalized its real symmetric adjacency; evaluated all 1770 two-vertex eigenspace cyclic spans to recover precisely the four rank multiplicities (numerical diagnostic independent of integer rational elimination). The analytic invariant-subspace argument excludes nondecaying modes in the bright space for every J,γ_s,γ_t>0 and implies P_abs(ρ)=tr(Πbright ρ) for all density matrices, not finite-time capture rates.
